description: Template for releasing a new version with branching, quality gates, and auto-tagging

steps.title: Crear release branch para v{{version}}
steps.description: Crear branch: git checkout dev && git checkout -b release/v{{version}} && git push -u origin release/v{{version}}. Esta branch se usa para preparativos finales antes de merge a prod.

steps.title: Preparar CHANGELOG para v{{version}}
steps.description: Actualizar CHANGELOG.md con los cambios incluidos en v{{version}}. {{description}}. Commit: chore: prepare release v{{version}}

steps.title: Rust: Bump version a {{version}}
steps.description: Actualizar Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock y kn.toml a version {{version}}. Commit: chore: bump version to {{version}}

steps.title: Security: Audit pre-release v{{version}}
steps.description: Ejecutar Trivy, Semgrep y Gitleaks sobre el codigo a liberar. Verificar que no hay vulnerabilidades criticas.

steps.title: QA: Smoke tests pre-release v{{version}}
steps.description: Ejecutar smoke tests: kn doctor, kn update, instalacion limpia. Verificar funcionalidad basica.

steps.title: Crear PR release/v{{version}}→prod
steps.description: Crear PR: gh pr create --base prod --head release/v{{version}} --title 'release: v{{version}}' --body '{{description}}'. Este merge a prod triggerea auto-tag-prod.yml que crea el tag v{{version}} y dispara el release workflow.

steps.title: Gate: Aprobacion de release v{{version}}

gate.description: Verificacion final antes de merge a prod. El merge auto-genera tag v{{version}} via GitHub Actions.

steps.description: Gate de aprobacion humana. Verificar que security audit y QA smoke tests pasaron. Merge PR a prod para trigger auto-tag.
